Address: 604 West Lancaster Avenue, Bryn Mawr

name: The Black Cat Cafe
summary: Restaurant on Berkeley Road, Devon.
facts: Non-profit cat cafe owned and operated by the PALS pet rescue.
All proceeds fund care for homeless, injured and sick cats and kittens.

name: The Cheese Company
summary: Café on Haverford Avenue, Narberth.
facts: Owned by Soheila Sobhani and stocks cheeses, breads, bagels, charcuterie and prepared sandwiches.
Also offers gift baskets and catering.

name: The Choice
summary: European restaurant on West Lancaster Avenue.
facts: Opened in December 2017 in the space formerly occupied by Vge Cafe.
Chef Volodymyr Hyvel co-owns it with his brother-in-law, Igor Hanushchak.
BYOB dining room of about 40 seats.

name: The Goat's Beard
summary: Restaurant on North Wayne Avenue, Wayne.
facts: New American restaurant working with local farmers and purveyors on seasonal menus.
Wayne is the second location; the other is in Manayunk.

name: The Gypsy Saloon
summary: Restaurant on Ford Street, Conshohocken.
facts: Founded by Kim Strengari and Marianne Gere, known as the Conshy Girls, who met bartending in 1990.
Part of Conshy Girls Restaurant Group, which also runs Southern Cross Kitchen and a catering company.

name: The Juice Merchant
summary: Smoothie restaurant on East Montgomery Avenue, Narberth.

name: The Pullman Restaurant and Bar
summary: American restaurant on Morris Avenue, Bryn Mawr.
facts: The restaurant opened in the former Bryn Mawr freight station.

name: The Silverspoon
summary: Restaurant on West Lancaster Avenue, Wayne.
facts: Contemporary American dishes from classically trained chefs in a bouchon-style room.
BYOB with no corkage fee, and offers event catering.
hours: Mon closed; Tue–Sat 11:30am–2:30pm; Tue–Sat 5pm–8pm; Sun 11am–2:30pm; Sun 4:30pm–7:30pm

name: The Tomato Shack
summary: Restaurant on Harry Street, Conshohocken.
facts: Salad and pizza spin-off of the Couch Tomato Cafe, which opened in Manayunk in 2003.
This Conshohocken shop opened in 2022 as the model unit for the franchise concept.

name: Tiffin
summary: Indian restaurant on West Lancaster Avenue.
facts: Part of Tiffin, which began in Northern Liberties in 2007 as a web and delivery service.
Opened after Tiffin's Mt. Airy, Elkins Park and Wynnewood locations.

name: Tiffin Cuisine
summary: Indian restaurant on East Wynnewood Road, Wynnewood.
facts: Part of Tiffin, which began in Northern Liberties in 2007 as a web and delivery service.
Fourth Tiffin location, opened after Mt. Airy and Elkins Park.

name: Tony & Joe's Pizzeria
summary: Pizza restaurant on Fayette Street, Conshohocken.
facts: Family-run restaurant serving Italian cooking for about thirty years.
Menu draws on family recipes for home-style pastas.

name: Trattoria Totaro
summary: Italian restaurant on Spring Mill Avenue, Conshohocken.
facts: Family-owned BYOB restaurant that also does off-premise catering and private parties.
Sells its own Roasted Garlic Olive Oil in its online store.

name: Up-Ryes Bagel
summary: Bagel shop on North Bryn Mawr Avenue, Bryn Mawr.
facts: Makes hand-rolled bagels and deli-style sandwiches.
Offers breakfast and lunch catering for pickup or delivery.
Address: 22 North Bryn Mawr Avenue, Bryn Mawr

name: Vedge
summary: Fine dining restaurant on Locust Street, Philadelphia.

name: Vernick Coffee Bar
summary: located in the Comcast Technology Center, 2nd floor lobby; building entrance on 18th between JFK & Arch streets.
facts: Run by James Beard Award-winning chef Greg Vernick.
Pairs Caffe Umbria coffee with house-baked goods and fresh-pressed juices.
Has a full-service 40-seat cafe beside the takeaway bakery and barista bar.

name: Vic & Deans
summary: Pizza restaurant on West Wayne Avenue, Wayne.
facts: Menu includes stromboli, calzones, paninis, hoagies and grinders.
Makes cauliflower crust and gluten-free pizzas.
Makes cheesesteaks, including a chicken version.

name: Villa Artigiano
summary: Italian restaurant on West Lancaster Avenue, Ardmore.
facts: Family-owned BYO Italian restaurant with dishes from various regions of Italy.
Also offers off-site catering and private events.

name: White Dog Cafe
summary: American restaurant on West Lancaster Avenue, Wayne.
facts: White Dog Cafe has served local, seasonal and sustainable food since 1983.

name: Win Wah
summary: Chinese restaurant on Fayette Street, Conshohocken.
facts: Listed as an Asian BYOB restaurant.
Established in 1982 and sells Chinese food and fresh sushi.
Current owner took over the business in 2011.

name: Yapple Yogurt
summary: Ice cream shop on East Wynnewood Road.
facts: Self-serve frozen yogurt shop with about 12 flavors that rotate every three weeks.
Toppings range from fresh fruit to crushed Oreos and strawberry juice balls.
